label_definitions.cad: Dataset label "Cath = CAD": coronary artery disease by angiography (>= 50% stenosis in at least one major vessel, per the dataset definition)
label_definitions.lad: Dataset label: >= 50% stenosis of the left anterior descending artery by angiography
label_definitions.lcx: Dataset label: >= 50% stenosis of the left circumflex artery by angiography
label_definitions.rca: Dataset label: >= 50% stenosis of the right coronary artery by angiography
